title: The old Cards page has no retirement step: ~61,000 lines and a second implementation of every Cards feature stay live after the flip
where: MulticamPipeline multicam_pipeline/cards/page/*.js (24 files, 32,741 lines), tests/*.js (44 files, 28,022 lines); ccsync docs/CARDS_EDITOR.md:161-180; editor PARITY.md:40, :291
what: The flip moves the old page to /cards/old for one release but names no step that deletes it, its JS tests, its page-only handler routes or the offline seam the native apps load. Every Cards change has two homes (32.7k JS vs 91k TS) and PARITY.md is the hand-kept ledger between them.
cost: Every Cards change x2 implementations; 28k lines of page tests in the Cards gate on every iteration. The Windows and Android apps (8,579 lines) still load the old page, so it cannot be deleted at the flip either - the apps are the hidden blocker.
evidence: git ls-files + wc -l: page 32,741; tests/*.js 28,022; editor TS 91,016 + 53,239 test lines; CARDS_EDITOR.md phase 5; PARITY.md rows 40 and 291 (the apps still load the old page).
fix: Add a phase 6 to CARDS_EDITOR.md: move the native apps to the new editor, then one release after the flip git rm cards/page/, the page tests and the page-only routes (keep /agent/* and what cards_tunnel and the companion role import), and drop the PARITY.md rows.

title: The footage sorter tracks 23.6 MB of manifest backups, move plans and logs, with real interviewee names, on GitHub, against its own .gitignore
where: footage-sorter data/manifest.backup-*.json (8), data/moveplan*.json (11), data/dupes-20260819.json, data/server.err.log, data/server.out.log; .gitignore (data/manifest.json, data/roster.json entries)
what: .gitignore keeps data/manifest.json out because it holds names of real people, yet eight timestamped full copies of it and the executed move plans are tracked and pushed to github.com/The-Creators-Club/footage-sorter; a sample carries Interviewees/<full name> paths.
cost: 23.6 MB per clone (the code is ~1 MB) and a documentary's interviewee list in a repo of a product going commercial.
evidence: git ls-files -z data | xargs -0 du -ck = 23,576 KB; git remote -v; grep of one backup for Interviewees/; .gitignore comment text.
fix: git rm --cached the backups, move plans, dupes and logs; add data/*.backup*, data/moveplan*, data/*.log to .gitignore (files stay on disk). History purge is a separate owner decision. Check SORTER_DEPLOY.md before touching episodes.json / settings.json.

title: The companion build collects all of onnxruntime: 306 .py files (3.87 MB) and 156 submodules of transformers/quantization/tools that the code never imports
where: ccsync companion/build.spec:80-93 (collect_all onnxruntime); uses: onnxruntime.InferenceSession, SessionOptions, get_available_providers only
what: collect_all defaults to include_py_files=True, so every .py under onnxruntime/ ships as a raw data file extracted on every start, and every importable submodule becomes a hidden import; 156 of 168 are exporter/optimiser tooling.
cost: ~4 MB and ~300 files of the 108 MB per-start extraction (lens-disk-3), on every editor machine, twice per start (companion + supervisor).
evidence: Companion venv, PyInstaller 6.21.0: collect_all returned 318 datas (306 .py, 3.87 MB), 168 hidden imports (156 under transformers/quantization/tools), binaries onnxruntime.dll 18.1 MB + providers_shared; grep of ccsync_companion for onnxruntime. finds the three names only.
fix: Replace collect_all with collect_dynamic_libs(onnxruntime) + hiddenimports onnxruntime, onnxruntime.capi.onnxruntime_pybind11_state, onnxruntime.capi._pybind_state + the notices file; prove with tools/scan_frozen.py and a frozen CLAP-sidecar smoke. Must not drop the DLLs.

title: ffmpeg_tools twins: the indexer's copy has no timeout on any of its ten ffmpeg/ffprobe calls, and the verbatim-twin helpers are not pinned across the two copies
what: 145 shared normalised lines. count_frames gained timeout + TimeoutExpired only in the companion; _plausible_frames (docstring: a verbatim twin) coerces with float() only in the companion. test_ffmpeg_tools.py imports the indexer for the preview flags but does not compare frames_match, _plausible_frames, parse_frame_count or count_frames_cmd.
cost: The indexer reads originals over SMB on the base rig for ~5,000-clip runs; one ffprobe stuck on a stalled read blocks its worker forever with no error. The unpinned helpers are the three-checks-each-thought-another-had-looked shape of the Reproductive Rights defect.
evidence: funcdiff.py: _plausible_frames ratio 0.40, count_frames 0.47 (diffs in scratchpad); no timeout= on any indexer subprocess.run.
fix: Give the indexer's probes PROBE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS (and encodes a duration-scaled timeout); add four assertions to test_ffmpeg_tools.py comparing the indexer's frames_match, _plausible_frames, parse_frame_count, count_frames_cmd on the same inputs. Keep frames_match exact.

title: Cards read-only guard is a second hand-kept list beside the route chain and has drifted: /api/fade writes a read-only project
what: READONLY_BLOCK lists 53 cut-changing paths against 64 POST branches. /api/fade (2026-09-15) changes the cut and is missing while its sibling /api/gain is present; ProjectEngine relies on the handler's one guard and _do_fade -> _save has no readonly check.
cost: A standalone server.py --project X --readonly session (not the dashboard mount): dragging a fade handle writes the .cut.md that was opened read-only.
evidence: Set difference of POST paths minus READONLY_BLOCK = 22 paths; only /api/fade writes the cut (set_note checks readonly itself); code paths quoted.
fix: Add /api/fade to READONLY_BLOCK and make ProjectEngine._save refuse when self.readonly. Do not refactor the handler: it retires with the old page (lens-dup-1).

title: The Cards media-job recipes are pinned against a literal, the shape audit F8 already found fails nothing when the other side moves
what: CLAUDE.md says jobs_media reproduces library_engine's argv VERBATIM; the test compares jobs_media to a hand-copied list, so a change on the Cards side fails nothing. They agree today (checked by hand).
cost: One edit to _vid_make in the Cards repo -> fleet-made and engine-made proxies differ silently for the same clip.
evidence: Test text and the three library_engine.py argv blocks.
fix: When the Cards checkout is present, read the argv from library_engine.py (or expose module constants there) and compare; skip with a reason when absent, like test_music_clap_sidecar.py.

title: Dead dashboard feature and an expired shim: editor_prefs.project_root_override and truenas_client.py
what: set_/get_project_root_override, get_detected_project_root and machine_by_machine_id have zero callers in all four trees; editor_prefs is touched only by db.py. truenas_client.py is an import shim KEPT FOR ONE RELEASE since 2026-08-17 that nothing imports.
cost: ~120 lines and a table that look live in a 13k-line db.py; small.
evidence: deadfuncs5.py zero-reference result, confirmed by grep for each name across all four trees.
fix: Delete the four functions and the shim (update the two comments citing truenas_client.py:165); leave the table and migrations.
